subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 00/10] mountd: bugfixes for up/downcall interfaces

reviews.author: Jeff Layton
reviews.summary: The patch series addresses several bugs in the mountd service, including issues related to crossmnt and autofs configurations, statfs errors, and deferred fsid lookups. The patches are well-structured and follow standard kernel coding practices.

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch series addresses several bugs in the mountd service, including issues related to crossmnt and autofs configurations, statfs errors, and deferred fsid lookups. The patches factor out per-path export attribute computation, handle unmountable paths and junctions, answer rejected requests, prevent parent export's fsid from leaking onto submounts, retry unresolvable fsid lookups, bound the junction path, give each worker its own netlink command socket, and drop deferred fsid lookups once answered.
